nodes.description: Constant public address of the legacy TrueUSD proxy (OldTrueUSDInterface at 0x8dd5fbCe2F6a956C3022bA3663759011Dd51e73E) that UpgradeHelper takes ownership of and delegates to the new contract
Constant public address of the new TrueUSD proxy (NewTrueUSDInterface at 0x0000000000085d4780B73119b644AE5ecd22b376) that becomes the target of the migration
Constant public address of the TokenController (TokenControllerInterface at 0x0000000000075EfBeE23fe2de1bd0b7690883cc9) used to perform ownership, storage and registry migration
Constant registry address configured on the TokenController via setTusdRegistry
Constant global pause address configured on the TokenController via setGlobalPause
Public upgrade() entry point that performs the whole migration: takes ownership of controller and both tokens, rewires storage, and hands ownership back to the end owner
Local variable holding tokenController.owner() at the start of upgrade(); used as the final owner restored at the end of the migration
Local variable holding the address returned by oldTrueUSD.balances(), the balance-sheet storage contract to be reclaimed and transferred
Local variable holding the address returned by oldTrueUSD.allowances(), the allowance-sheet storage contract to be reclaimed and transferred
External call that makes UpgradeHelper the owner of the TokenController, granting full privileged control over the whole system
External call that makes UpgradeHelper the owner of the new TrueUSD proxy
External call that makes UpgradeHelper the owner of the legacy TrueUSD proxy
Privileged delegation call pointing the legacy TrueUSD proxy at the new contract, executed after UpgradeHelper has claimed ownership of oldTrueUSD
Final ownership hand-back of the TokenController to the previously recorded end owner
Ownership transfer of the new TrueUSD proxy to the TokenController during the migration sequence
Controller-side claim of ownership over the new TrueUSD contract
Controller-side registration of the new TrueUSD address used by the controller for token operations
Controller-side rewiring of the balance sheet, allowance sheet and delegate for the proxy during the migration

edges.reason: upgrade() calls tokenController.claimOwnership() to become owner of the TokenController
upgrade() calls newTrueUSD.claimOwnership() to become owner of the new TrueUSD
upgrade() calls oldTrueUSD.claimOwnership() to become owner of the legacy TrueUSD
upgrade() executes the privileged delegateToNewContract call after many external calls, allowing a malicious delegate target to re-enter the partially migrated state
The tokenController state variable is the external contract whose claimOwnership() is invoked
The newTrueUSD state variable is the external contract whose claimOwnership() is invoked
The oldTrueUSD state variable is the external contract whose claimOwnership() is invoked
oldTrueUSD is the proxy on which the privileged delegateToNewContract delegation is performed, changing its implementation to newTrueUSD
newTrueUSD is passed as the delegation target, so all legacy proxy calls start executing new contract code that can re-enter upgrade()
endOwner is populated from tokenController.owner() before any ownership is taken over
endOwner read from the external controller is used as the destination of the final ownership transfer, so a stale or malicious owner value controls who ends up owning the TokenController
tokenController is the contract whose ownership is transferred to endOwner at the end of the migration
newTrueUSD ownership is handed to the TokenController, centralising privileged control of the token
tokenController receives ownership of newTrueUSD during the migration
newTrueUSD is the child contract whose ownership the controller claims via issueClaimOwnership
tokenController is the external contract executing issueClaimOwnership over newTrueUSD
newTrueUSD is registered as the TrueUSD address on the controller
tokenController is the contract on which setTrueUSD(newTrueUSD) is invoked
balanceSheetAddress is assigned from the external oldTrueUSD.balances() call
allowanceSheetAddress is assigned from the external oldTrueUSD.allowances() call
balanceSheetAddress obtained from the legacy token is used to rewire the controller storage via claimStorageForProxy
allowanceSheetAddress obtained from the legacy token is used to rewire the controller storage via claimStorageForProxy
newTrueUSD is the delegate proxy bound to the reclaimed balance and allowance sheets
tokenController executes claimStorageForProxy to bind the storage contracts to the new proxy
delegateToNewContract causes subsequent calls on oldTrueUSD to execute code inside newTrueUSD, a callback path that can re-enter UpgradeHelper while the migration is incomplete

normalization_plan.reason: endOwner is a temporary local produced by tokenController.owner() and consumed only by the final ownership transfer, so it can be absorbed into that unsafe ownership operation
balanceSheetAddress is a transient handle returned by oldTrueUSD.balances() whose only meaningful sink is the storage rewiring call, so it collapses into that unsafe operation
allowanceSheetAddress is a transient handle returned by oldTrueUSD.allowances() whose only meaningful sink is the storage rewiring call, so it collapses into that unsafe operation
